description: This file defines Express.js routes for session and tenant management in an authentication context. It includes endpoints for listing tenants, setting the active tenant, selecting tenants, and toggling super admin modes, with integrated audit logging and RBAC.

classes.name: Router
classes.description: Express.js Router object used to define session and tenant management HTTP endpoints.

methods.name: GET /api/session/tenants
methods.description: Returns the list of tenants accessible to the current authenticated user.

methods.name: POST /api/session/tenant
methods.description: Sets the active tenant for the current session after RBAC validation, and sets a cookie.

methods.name: POST /api/tenants/select
methods.description: Alias route for selecting an active tenant, reusing the /api/session/tenant handler.

methods.name: POST /api/session/all-tenants
methods.description: Allows a super admin to toggle the global scope to ignore tenant filters for the session.
